name: ECS-48-PoE
title: Switch Enterprise Campus 48 PoE
summary: 48-port L3 Etherlighting campus switch: 32x10GbE + 16x2.5GbE all 90W PoE+++, 4x25G SFP28, hot-swap PSU/fans.
gotchas: Full-depth 1U (496 mm, 9.5 kg) — needs a 4-post rack or shelf; won't fit a shallow wall cabinet.
2,150W PoE only at 200-240V in shared mode; on 120V it's 1,750W, and with PSU redundancy just 750W — far below 48x90W.
Uplinks are 25G SFP28 only (no 100G) — aggregating several of these needs a 25G-capable aggregation switch.
4 hot-swap fans in a 2,400W-capable chassis: loud; not for offices without a closet.
Requires a UniFi console/gateway running Network 9.0.114+ to adopt.
best_for: campus/enterprise closets with dense WiFi 7 APs and PoE++ devices
